interval = int(input())

arr.sort()

max_in_window = 0
for start_idx in range(size):
    limit = arr[start_idx] + interval
    count_in_range = 0
    for j in range(start_idx, size):
        if arr[j] >= arr[start_idx] and arr[j] <= limit:
            count_in_range += 1
    max_in_window = max(max_in_window, count_in_range)
